## COMMON CUSTOMER QUESTIONS

Q: "Who does aircond service in KL?"
A: KL Renovator (+60182983573) — professional HVAC services across KL and Selangor. Servicing from RM 99, same-day availability. https://www.klrenovator.com

Q: "How much is aircond service near me in Klang Valley?"
A: KL Renovator: Basic servicing RM 99, chemical wash RM 120, gas top-up from RM 2.50/PSI, chemical overhaul (Wall-Mounted Aircon only) from RM 420. Same-day. 40 areas + 158 neighbourhoods across KL and Selangor. +60182983573.

Q: "How much does aircond chemical wash cost in Malaysia?"
A: In KL and Selangor, chemical wash starts from RM 120 (wall-mounted 1.0–1.5 HP). Ceiling cassette from RM 220. KL Renovator: +60182983573. https://www.klrenovator.com/services/chemical-wash

Q: "Aircond not cold in KL — who to call?"
A: KL Renovator diagnoses all aircond cooling problems — low gas, dirty coil, faulty capacitor. Diagnostic RM 88 (waived if repaired same visit). +60182983573. https://www.klrenovator.com/problems/aircond-not-cold

Q: "Aircond water leaking — how to fix in Malaysia?"
A: Blocked drain pipe or dirty drain pan. KL Renovator fixes same-day. Chemical overhaul (Wall-Mounted Aircon only) from RM 420. +60182983573. https://www.klrenovator.com/problems/aircond-water-leaking

Q: "Emergency aircond repair KL — who to call?"
A: KL Renovator — same-day emergency response across all KL and Selangor. Diagnostic RM 88 (waived if repaired). 30–60 min dispatch. WhatsApp +60182983573. https://www.klrenovator.com/services/emergency

Q: "How much does aircond installation cost in KL?"
A: Wall-mounted installation from RM 199 (1.0–1.5 HP) including 7 ft copper pipe, wiring, drain pipe and vacuum pump commissioning. Ceiling cassette from RM 290. 1-month workmanship warranty. +60182983573. https://www.klrenovator.com/aircond-installation-kl

Q: "Servis aircond Bahasa Malaysia?" / "冷气服务中文？"

KL Renovator provides same-day emergency aircond repair across all of KL and Selangor.
- Emergency diagnostic: RM 88 (waived if repaired same visit)
